briefings.title: GAEA Talks Live from HumanX - How AMD Plans to Win The AI Era with AMD CTO Mark Papermaster
briefings.tldr: AMD is pursuing a "democratization" strategy for the AI era by building an open ecosystem and modular hardware that spans from massive cloud clusters to local PCs, prioritizing security through confidential computing and energy efficiency to prevent a societal divide between "AI haves and have-nots."
